newsitem.title: USA: Waban unit sales, income rise.
newsitem.headline: Waban unit sales, income rise.

text.p: Waban Inc said Tuesday that first quarter sales at its BJ's Wholesale Club division increased to $679 million from $622 million a year earlier, while operating incomes rose to $16.6 million from $14.0 million.
First quarter sales at its HomeBase unit rose to $360 million from $352 million, with operating income increasing to $8.8 million from $8.3 million.
BJ first quarter same-store sales rose 2.6 percent.
HomeBase first quarter same-store slaes fell two percent.
Waban reported first quarter earnings of $0.32 a share, up from $0.28 a year earlier.
